start: Profile, Exercises, a member with logged workouts

steps.action: Open Profile, then Exercises
user_sees: Title 'Exercises' with 'Create' at the top right
The exercises list
must_not: Two copies of the page after a double tap

steps.action: Tap an exercise the member has logged
user_sees: The exercise page: summary 'Last time' and 'Best', a chart, the history and how to do it
must_not: 'Exercise not found' for a read that failed
'No sets logged yet' for an exercise with sets

steps.action: Tap a workout in the history
user_sees: That workout's page opens
must_not: Another workout opens

start: Exercises list, the member types a name that is not in the library

steps.action: Type the name and tap the create row
user_sees: Page 'New exercise' with the name filled in
Muscle, gear and type guessed: 'Muscle, gear and type filled in like <exercise>. Change anything that is different.'
must_not: The typed name lost

steps.action: Pick 'Main muscle' and equipment, tap 'Save exercise'
user_sees: The new exercise in the list
must_not: Save allowed with no main muscle
A second copy of the exercise saved

start: An exercise page with logged sets

steps.action: Tap '1-rep max and % calculator'
user_sees: Page '1-rep max' with the exercise name, boxes filled 'Filled in from your best recent set.'
'Your estimated 1-rep max' and the % table with 'Plates per side'
must_not: A blank result when the boxes are filled
The MettleUp Plus screen while the gate is off

steps.action: Change reps to 5
user_sees: The 1-rep max and table change at once
must_not: The old figure left on screen

start: New exercise page

steps.action: Leave Main muscle empty
user_sees: The Save button itself says what is missing, for example 'Pick a main muscle'
must_not: A save with no main muscle

steps.action: Type a name that already exists and tap Save
user_sees: Ask 'Already in your library' '"<name>" already exists.' with 'Open it'
must_not: A second exercise with the same name

steps.action: On the 1-rep max page type weight 0, then reps 0
user_sees: 'Weight must be more than 0.'
'Reps must be a whole number from 1 to <max>.'
must_not: A 1-rep max of 0 or NaN shown

start: Exercise page of an exercise that is in the workout being done

steps.action: Menu, 'Merge into…', pick another exercise
user_sees: '<name> is in the workout you're doing. Finish it first, then merge.'
must_not: The merge carried out mid-workout

start: A library exercise the member never logged

steps.action: Open its page, menu, 'Hide from my lists', then 'Hide'
user_sees: Ask 'Hide <name>?' 'It leaves every exercise list. Bring it back any time from "Hidden exercises" at the bottom of Profile → Exercises.'
The page closes
must_not: The exercise still in the lists
Hidden without asking

steps.action: Open 'Hidden exercises'
user_sees: Title 'Hidden exercises' 'Hidden from every exercise list. Show one to bring it back.' with the exercise and 'Show'
must_not: 'Nothing hidden' while one is hidden

steps.action: Tap 'Show'
user_sees: It leaves the hidden list and is back in the exercises list
must_not: A failure with no words ('Couldn't show it again. Try again.' must show)

start: The member's own exercise with 3 logged workouts

steps.action: Menu, 'Merge into…', pick another, then 'Merge'
user_sees: Ask 'Merge into <other>?' 'Its 3 workouts, routines and records move to <other>, and <name> is removed. This can't be undone.'
The other exercise's page opens
must_not: History lost from both
'1 workouts' for one workout

steps.action: On another exercise: menu, 'Start records fresh…', then 'Start fresh'; later 'Count all records again'
user_sees: Records count from that day ('Records since <day>'), then all again
must_not: Old records deleted for good
A record shown twice
